title: A text-message agent is a list. It is not a test.
friendlyTitle: A list of text-message helpers is not a test.
summary: On 21 November, TechCrunch listed agents you can reach by text instead of a new app. Ask Proxy's personal plan is $1 a day over SMS. Folk's Pro plan is $8.33 a month. Comma is free to start and open source, over Signal, Telegram, and WeChat. Fambot, for family calendars, is free in beta.
friendlySummary: On 21 November, TechCrunch listed helpers you can reach by text, instead of installing another app. Ask Proxy's personal plan is $1 a day by SMS. Folk's Pro plan is $8.33 a month. Comma is free to start and open source, over Signal, Telegram, and WeChat. Fambot, for family calendars, is free while it is in testing.
whyItMatters: TechCrunch is describing what the companies say the agents can do, not measuring whether they finish the task. Texting one means connecting a calendar, email, or messages. A roundup is not a comparison, and a price is not a result.
